name: list_installed_software
description: List all installed software from Windows registry
task_prompt:
Write a Python script that reads the Windows registry to list all installed software.
Check all three uninstall keys:
  HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall
  HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall
  HKLM\Software\Wow6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall
Use winreg. For each subkey read: DisplayName, DisplayVersion, Publisher, InstallDate.
Skip entries without a DisplayName. Sort alphabetically. Print as a table.
Show total count at the end.
